title: tectaria biformis
intro: Tectaria biformis, commonly known as the Bifurcate Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria biformis include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
